# Bilingual Parity Overlay

Treat English and Portuguese docs as structural mirrors by default.

Translate meaning rather than wording, but preserve mirrored structure and navigation unless a divergence is intentional and explained.

## Follow-Through Triggers

If a covered English or Portuguese file changes structure, update the mirrored side and the validation that protects parity in the same change.

If a covered portal or index changes navigation, update the mirrored navigation.
